request: 노래 끝까지 노트, 노트 수 증가, 조금 빠른 낙하, DJ MAX처럼 성공 타격감 강화

findings.cutoff: 61 auction charts ended at 30s regardless of the 34.765–67.453s original songs; audio retained only 31s.
findings.timer: Keeping the fixed 210s enrage would make longer three-song playlists run out of time.
findings.packaging: Tracked chart authoring helper initially raised public asset count to 20,001. Preserve it in Git and exclude only its unused public copy.

loopVisits.comparison: same longest chart, one frame every 16.67ms; excludes binary-search comparisons; algorithm count, not measured browser speed

changes.fullSong: RMS onset anchors across every complete MP3; measured-pulse continuation through rests/fades, two-key accents distributed through the song, same-lane separation >=330ms. Last note 200–483ms before actual end.
changes.feedback: Existing approved impact artwork with lane light, brighter receptor, short pressure/rebound of the pressed key, PERFECT/GOOD readout and combo emphasis; quiet 110ms percussive hit audio. Empty input has no success burst/sound; reduced motion removes recoil/beam. No new image downloads.
changes.enrage: Original 210s plus the three songs’ duration beyond their old 30s segments; floor, co-op, attack and transition windows unchanged.
changes.compatibility: Full-song track IDs end in -full1. All 61 legacy charts and the original fixed chart are byte-for-byte data equivalent. Version 4 required to create/join/ready/start; already active legacy rooms retain their charts/deadlines.
changes.performance: Binary-search visible note range; reuse decoded complete audio buffers directly; only the three chosen songs retained; six simultaneous hit voices maximum; timers update text only when it changes; stop all voices/animations and free song buffers on exit.

verification.tests: 34 focused tests including full 61-song timing/spacing, longest three-song playlists in 3/6 players, legacy compatibility, input streams, fees/rollback, floor/art lifetime, bounded hit audio and packaging; Worker syntax.

performance.conditions: Windows shared development host; headless Chrome, Android touch/H5/Windows URL emulation, local PGlite API; real menu → world raid → Nox → prepare/play → leave. Physical phones and installed apps not tested. First/reentry compared with same 3 songs, same viewport and same unchanged static file root. Concurrent unrelated work introduces host load variance; no speedup claim.
performance.bottleneck: Local sparse Git asset reads/HTTP waits and V3 preparation/main-thread tasks dominated loading; full-song decode totals approximately 0.4–0.8s in measured runs. Deployment-era tests shared host load. Long frames and initialization tasks are retained in every report; a pre-optimization cold run reached 1051ms. The complete final chart still accepted 189/189 +110ms inputs with calibration 0.
performance.comparisonCaveat: Full-song final/retry runs have a longer active period and reuse the iframe; use matchedFinal versus baseline for first/reentry comparison. Public run uses live static assets with an isolated API, not production account gameplay.
